title: Great!
text: Great!. My daughter is moving into a new place next week. She has been using these organizers and setting up her dresser drawers with them. She is very happy with how these are working. It is making organization very simple. She's nearly finished with the drawers. We will be wrapping the individual drawers with packing cellophane and they won't be transported in the dresser. So when she is setting up her new bedroom, the dresser will be ready in no time. She especially likes how her t-shirts look now that they're organized. She says its easy to find what she needs. Since there are dividers, removing one shirt doesn't affect the rest.
